components.name: Dark Button with Pill
components.description: Primary action on the site; the blue pill slides across on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px 0 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: #fff; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #0a0a0a 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18); } .ds-pill { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: 36px; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a7bff 0%, #155dfc 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transition: width .2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); } .ds-btn-dark:hover .ds-pill, .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible .ds-pill { width: calc(100% - 8px); } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #155dfc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-dark:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Light Button with Pill
components.css: .ds-btn-light { position: relative; overflow: hidden; height: 44px; padding: 0 16px 0 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; color: #0a0a0a; font: 500 14px/20px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #ededed 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.08), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.06); } .ds-pill { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: 36px; border-radius: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a7bff 0%, #155dfc 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transition: width .2s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1); } .ds-btn-light:hover .ds-pill, .ds-btn-light:focus-visible .ds-pill { width: calc(100% - 8px); } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #155dfc; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-light:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Blue Button
components.description: Primary action inside the desktop app (Copy, Open, Extract style).
components.css: .ds-btn-blue { height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; font: 500 13px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a7bff 0%, #155dfc 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); transition: filter .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-blue:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn-blue:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-blue:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #155dfc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Tabs and format switches: Cloud track, raised paper segment.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 11px; background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-seg button { height: 30px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #364153; font: 500 13px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:hover { color: #0f1324; } .ds-seg button.on { background: #fff; color: #0f1324; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #155dfc; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; outline: 0; background: #fff; color: #0f1324; font: 14px Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #e5e7eb, 0 1px 2px rgba(15,19,36,.04); transition: box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6b7280; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #155dfc, 0 0 0 4px rgba(21,93,252,.1); }

components.name: Tile
components.description: White sheet on a sky stage or board.
components.css: .ds-tile { width: 240px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(15,19,36,.06), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,24,128,.06); } .ds-tile h3 { margin: 0; font: 400 22px/1.1 'Stack Sans Headline', Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #001880; } .ds-tile p { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 13px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; color: #6b7280; }

components.name: Tag Label
components.description: Uppercase cobalt label with dot separators.
components.css: .ds-tags { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font: 600 12px/16px Inter, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1447e6; } .ds-tags i { width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Code Block
components.description: The one dark surface: exported code.
components.css: .ds-code { margin: 0; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 12px; color: #d6d4e6; font: 500 12px/1.65 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #0a0a0a 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08), 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }

components.name: Sky Stage
components.description: The signature container: the hero's sky wash holding a live demonstration.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 320px; height: 200px; border-radius: 20px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(0,188,255,.2), rgba(0,188,255,0) 85%), #f9fafb; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,24,128,.08); } .ds-key { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 14px; color: #fff; font: 600 24px Inter, sans-serif; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a7bff 0%, #155dfc 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.08); }

narrative.overview:
Layoutly is a workbench set out under a clear sky. The surfaces are light and airy: near-white paper under a cyan wash that fades down from the top of the hero and every "stage" that holds a demonstration. On those surfaces sit tools you can almost pick up: buttons, keycaps and pills cut from three stocks (white, black and signal blue) with a highlight on top and a soft shadow underneath. The product is an inspector, but it refuses the dark DevTools mood; it brings inspection into daylight.

Type does the talking. Headlines are set in Stack Sans Headline in deep navy, with the phrase that matters switched to its sibling, Stack Sans Notch, in cobalt. Everything else is quiet Inter in slate and steel. Code is the only thing that stays dark: code blocks are black slabs, because that is where syntax color reads best.

The same world runs through the marketing site (`website/`) and the desktop app (`src/renderer/`). The site is the reference; the app follows it.
keyCharacteristics: Light surfaces with the sky wash (cyan at 20% fading to transparent) marking "stages".
Navy Stack Sans headlines with one Notch phrase in cobalt.
Tactile controls from three stocks: light, dark and blue.
Hairlines (1px) and small square ticks frame sections.
Code is dark; everything else is light.

rules.name: The One Blue Action Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue marks what you can do or what is active. Headlines never use it; they use Deep Navy and Cobalt.

rules.name: The Sky Is a Wash Rule
rules.body: Sky Cyan only ever appears as the fading gradient. A solid cyan fill or a cyan border is off-system.

rules.name: The Client's Colors Rule
rules.body: Colors extracted from a user's site (style board cards, swatches) are content, shown as-is. They never restyle the chrome around them.

rules.name: The One Notch Phrase Rule
rules.body: A headline may switch one phrase to Stack Sans Notch in Cobalt ("Copy *any website component*", "One *key.*"). Never more than one per heading.

rules.name: The Mono Means Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only for code, values and measurements.

rules.name: The Offset Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow has a downward offset and a soft blur. No zero-offset colored glows.

dos: **Do** put new demonstrations on a sky stage and new reading content on paper.
**Do** build controls from the three stocks (light, dark, blue) with their shadows as listed above.
**Do** keep headlines at weight 400 in Deep Navy, with at most one Notch phrase in Cobalt.
**Do** draw icons as SVG (Lucide paths, 1.75 to 2px stroke) inside light-stock chips.
**Do** keep code blocks dark and everything around them light.
**Do** theme the browser surfaces: focus rings, selection (Signal Blue at 18%), thin scrollbars.
donts: **Don't** use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons.
**Don't** add dark full-page surfaces; the only dark elements are code, the site nav, dark buttons and toasts.
**Don't** use purple (#7c5cff) or other off-family accents in the chrome; that was the old identity.
**Don't** use gradient text, glassmorphism as decoration, or zero-offset colored glows.
**Don't** use monospace for anything that is not code, a value or a measurement.
